title: 127 m² Three-Room Apartment Interior Design, Bratislava
description: A 127 m² three-room apartment in Bratislava: “Basic” package design project, 3D visualization, and technical drawings. Renovation underway.
h1: Three-room apartment interior design in Bratislava, 127 m²

blocks.text: Three-room apartment interior design in Bratislava, 127 m²

parts.html: A 127 m² three-bedroom apartment with a balcony in Bratislava. We developed its interior design project under the “Basic” package: a floor plan, 3D visualizations of every room and a full set of technical drawings for the renovation. The project is now being built, and the renovation is underway.

The apartment has a 43 m² living room opening onto the balcony, an 18.5 m² kitchen with a dining area, a 21.6 m² master bedroom, a 15 m² children’s room, an entrance hall, a laundry room, a bathroom and two WCs.

The interior is done in a warm beige-gray palette. The living rooms have wide light-oak floorboards; the entrance hall, kitchen and bathrooms have large-format tile that looks like light stone. The doors are flush and painted to match the walls, the curtains are tucked into ceiling recesses with concealed tracks, and the lighting comes from recessed linear fixtures and tracks.

The living room has a TV area with an oak panel and open shelves. Opposite are a sofa and two rounded armchairs, and a piano stands closer to the entrance hall. The kitchen is a separate room: a run of units along one wall with tall cabinets for the fridge and oven, and a dining table by the window.

The master bedroom has a bed with an upholstered headboard, a full-wall wardrobe without handles and a dressing table with a mirror. The children’s room has a desk by the window, a bed against an oak panel and wall bars with a climbing panel. The bathroom is finished in textured herringbone tile, and the WC has a niche with lit shelves.

The furniture is designed to the dimensions of each room: the kitchen, the TV area, wardrobes in the entrance hall, bedroom and children’s room, lit wall panels, vanity units and tall cabinets in the bathrooms. It comes with a separate custom furniture plan and a specification, and can be made at our own workshop.

The set of working drawings runs to 45 sheets: a measured floor plan, the layout and furniture arrangement, a custom furniture plan, partition installation, plumbing and heating, air conditioning, outlets, lighting and switches, ventilation, floors, ceilings with recesses for curtain tracks, wall finishes with NCS colors, and wall elevations for the kitchen, living room, hallway, children’s room, bedroom and bathrooms. The construction crew works from these drawings.
